description: Price a market order before placing it: estimated shares/amount, amount-weighted average price, worst-leg price, and a partial-fill flag, from the exact matching math a live order will meet. Reserves no maker liquidity and costs no gas, so call it as often as sizing requires. Read-only; no wallet proof required. SIZING A BUY — a bare `amount` is a ceiling on the TOTAL debited (base + taker fee together fit inside it), which is NOT what the same field means at Polymarket; pass amountMode "notional" for their meaning (pre-fee notional, fee charged on top), or `maxSpend` to state the ceiling explicitly. The response echoes `amountMode`, so read it rather than assuming. MINIMUMS — ONE floor. The venue's trading minimum is FLAT: one number, the same at every price, on either outcome, on every orderbook market, binding the amount you sent in the mode you sent it; a size under it answers 400 AMOUNT_BELOW_MINIMUM with `minAmountWei`, and the book snapshot publishes it as `effectiveMinBuyAmount` so you can size before asking. Each market still reports a `minBuyAmount` on that snapshot, but it is DEPRECATED AND UNENFORCED: settlement asserted it per settlement leg — the counterparty's leg of a complementary mint included, which made the felt minimum rise with the price — until the 2026-08-31 beacon upgrade removed the assertion across the whole catalog. Do not size against it and do not treat it as a floor. A market order is an immediate-or-cancel order — place it with problee_place_limit_order using timeInForce IOC and a price beyond the worst level this sweep touches. When this MCP session has a bound wallet, that address is excluded for self-trade prevention (matching REST sweep-estimate); with no wallet bound the estimate uses the zero address and may include your own resting orders, so treat it as optimistic.

McpOrderbookPriceBps.description: Limit price in basis points. Must land on this market's price grid, published as tradingRules.priceBands: default markets are BANDED — 10-bps rungs below 500 and above 9500, 100-bps rungs in between — and an off-grid price is refused with 400 PRICE_OFF_TICK naming the two nearest legal prices. Resting orders (GTC or postOnly) meet tradingRules.minRestingShares and minRestingExpirySeconds. Passive postOnly orders have no collateral-notional minimum (minRestingNotional is 0). Active BUY orders (postOnly absent or false) retain the book snapshot's effectiveMinBuyAmount: principal notional for GTC, total budget including fees for IOC/FOK. IOC/FOK SELL meets minSellShares. A verified entire-position SELL is exempt from size floors. There is no longer a per-fill collateral floor: settlement stopped asserting the market's minBuyAmount in the 2026-08-31 beacon upgrade, so that field is a deprecated, unenforced record and no size need be checked against it.

amount.description: Exact-input raw size in the market collateral's denomination. BUY: read as a TOTAL-SPEND CEILING by default — base + taker fee together land at or under this, so a typed 10 debits 10.000000 and never 10.03. Send amountMode "notional" to read it Polymarket-style instead: pre-fee notional, with the fee charged ON TOP (total debited = amount + fee). The venue's flat trading minimum binds THIS number as sent, in whichever mode you sent it, and is the same figure either way. SELL: collateral-denominated outcome-token units to sell; neither mode applies. Mutually exclusive with maxSpend — provide exactly one.

amountMode.description: BUY only. How to read the size. "total" (DEFAULT, and what every caller has always got) treats it as a ceiling on the total debited: base + taker fee ≤ amount. "notional" is Polymarket's `amount` meaning: buy this much of base and charge the fee on top, so the total debited is amount + fee and exceeds what you sent. The venue's flat trading minimum is the SAME NUMBER in both modes and binds the amount as sent — ten means ten debited under "total" and ten of pre-fee base under "notional" — so a wallet holding exactly the minimum can always send it. It is the only sizing floor: the market's stored minBuyAmount was retired as a settlement precondition in the 2026-08-31 beacon upgrade and refuses nothing. Any refusal bound comes back in the mode you sent, tagged with it. Refused on a sell, and refused alongside maxSpend.

chainId.description: Chain id for the market address. Required when the same market address exists on multiple chains.

limitPrice.description: Worst requested-side executable price: BUY maximum, SELL minimum.

maxSpend.description: BUY only. Cap the TOTAL debited — base plus taker fee — at this raw collateral amount; the sweep sizes down so the complete cost fits. Identical in meaning to a bare `amount`, spelled out: send this when the cap is the point and you want the request to say so rather than rely on a default. Mutually exclusive with `amount`, and refused together with amountMode "notional" (which asks for the opposite).

name: problee_estimate_market_order
title: Preview a market-order sweep without reserving liquidity — estimated fill, avg/worst price, partial-fill flag. Buys size by total spend, or by pre-fee notional
